claim.value: Diagnostic questions can change customer behavior.
claim.scope: Possible behavioral effects of diagnosis; no actual effect is reported.

provenance.rationale: P033 explicitly identifies diagnostic questions as a possible influence on behavior.

signal_basis.value: The operation asks customers about publication intentions, available information, offline preparation and stopping points, and may introduce a diagnostic prompt when evidence does not distinguish explanations.
signal_basis.scope: Customer-facing diagnostic questioning; no observed behavioral effect of the questions is asserted.

provenance.rationale: The cited spans describe the questioning and the condition for introducing a diagnostic prompt.
This component applies only to CONDITIONAL_WARRANT.

rationale: Diagnostic questions can direct attention to missing information or intended actions and thereby influence subsequent behavior. This licenses the bounded possibility of measurement reactivity without requiring evidence that it actually occurred.
uncertainty: Whether questioning changes behavior in these customers, and the direction or magnitude of any effect, remains unknown; the claim does not assert those stronger conclusions.
